title.narrative: Assam Power Sector Enhancement Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: Tranche 1 of the Assam Power Sector Enhancement Investment Program amounting to $49.6 million aims to fund a transmission system infrastructure improvement project in the state of Assam, India. It covers part of the state's power sector road map for enhancing the transmission capacities to improve operational efficiency and electricity service to end users. Tranche 1 will finance: (i) construction of 220 kV and 132 kV power transmission lines; (ii) construction of one 220/132 kV substation and five 132/33 kV substations; and (iii) extension and augmentation of two existing substations.

Progress Toward Outcome: The project closed on 31 March 2018. Physical verification will be undertaken during the preparation of PCR.
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Nov 2017: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/41614/41614-023-iee-en_0.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Aug 2017: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/41614/41614-023-rp-en.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Feb 2018: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/41614/41614-023-smr-en_0.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Eight packages (two consulting and six turnkey) awarded under this loan. The consulting packages are supporting the safeguard compliance requirements under the project. All six turnkey packages have been physically completed.
TA 7378: 85% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
